name: Baby
overview: Scripture reveals the sacredness of babies as a divine heritage and reward from the Lord, emphasizing God's intimate involvement even before birth, as seen in Psalms 127:3 and 139:13. The miraculous conception and birth of the Baby Jesus, foretold in Isaiah 7:14, highlights God's redemptive plan through a virgin birth. The tender care and compassion between mother and child are also underscored, reflecting God's unfailing remembrance and love, as expressed in Isaiah 49:15. These truths affirm the preciousness of life from conception through infancy, celebrating both the joy of birth and the nurturing role of mothers.
